note: Machine-readable kind vocabulary for the anchor contract (PORT-V2 design section 1). The validator loads this file and records/checks its sha256 via 'kindRegistrySha' in v1.1 anchors files. Builtin kinds are NON-OVERRIDABLE: family profiles ADD kinds through gated edits of this file, never redefine existing entries. 'unitsAllowed', when present, is enforced; 'toleranceNote' is convention documentation (the validator's numeric/exact rules remain the executable authority).

fx.description: Niagara FX ports. v1 anchors files (unnamespaced kinds) imply this family.

particle_count.description: live particle count on the node at the sample time

particle_bbox.description: axis-aligned bounding box of the particle buffer

particle_radial_range.description: min/max radial distance of particles from the emitter origin

particle_angular_distinct.description: number of distinct angular clusters in the particle distribution

particle_angular_max_gap.description: largest angular gap between neighboring particles

particle_motion_conformance.description: deviation of observed particle motion from the declared motion model

material_uniform.description: material uniform value; 'field' = uniform name (units vary by uniform: 0..1, coeff, factor, linear-rgb, m, m/s, s, uv, deg, enum, ...)

pass_state.description: render pass state; 'field' = state name (blendSrc, depthWrite, ...)

texture_binding.description: texture bound to a sampler slot; 'field' = slot/sampler name

sort_priority.description: render sort priority of the node relative to sibling FX

materials.description: Standalone material ports (PORT-V2 phase 2). Static binding anchors plus mandatory render_sample anchors for non-trivial graph math; sample points are profile-MANDATED (derive-render-points.py), never author-chosen.

uniform.description: material uniform value on the target; 'field' = uniform name (units vary by uniform)

pass_state.toleranceNote: exact for enums/flags; numeric abs for clip values and mip-level biases
pass_state.description: render pass state; 'field' = state name (blend mode, depth write, two-sided, alpha-test threshold, sampler.<slot>.<state> incl. lodBias in mip levels, ...)

texture_binding.description: texture bound to a sampler slot; 'field' = slot/sampler name

render_sample.description: rgba readback of the rendered material at one mandated UV point; 'field' = the point key emitted by derive-render-points.py (e.g. 'u0.500_v0.300'); expected is a 4-array
